references.text: Psalm 69:21 also mentions being given vinegar to drink, which is a direct parallel to the event described in Matthew 27:34.
Jeremiah 23:29-30, although it does not directly mention vinegar, speaks of bitterness and suffering that can be seen as a thematic connection to Matthew 27:34.
Deuteronomy 32:32 speaks of wine from the vineyards of Sodom mixed with poison, which can be interpreted as a symbolic precursor to the mixed drink mentioned in Matthew 27:34.
